Mina/Laura,

Looked into the suspense entries. Findings: 
- The payment application logic failed to match ST-443 because the credit note was issued against entity Redwood-EU but payment came from Stellara US. The remittance file had the entity tag omitted (we defaulted to Redwood-US).
- As a result the system posted to GL:2201 (suspense) and flagged for manual review.

Proposed correction steps: 
1) Create JV to move $6,400 from GL:2201 -> GL:110AR (apply to invoice 11033) with memo referencing ST-443 and DL-78493.
2) If Stellara wants ST-443 to be post-bill (affecting AR only), run an adjusting AR credit applying to 11033 instead of reversing revenue. If it should reduce revenue, we'll need a revenue reclass journal (Revmap code R-SETTLE).
3) Confirm VAT treatment: if taxable in US (no VAT), strip the 20% VAT lines and post as net credit; if treated as EU VAT, we need to run the VAT reclaim routine and adjust tax payable.

I can draft the JV and the AR apply script tonight; need customer confirmation on 2/3.

-Marcus
Senior Accounting Analyst
Redwood Inference
